verdict.summary: Review of marius-patrik/Andromeda issue #219 at verified version 3b9fe597164ef6c13eba25908605012884d17b8101497596a800ad0dd4f50fea is blocked by unresolved owner decisions, two circular or unauthorised prerequisite paths, and an ambiguous dev-to-main delivery contract.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner decisions remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: The contract cannot begin or complete several required stages until authenticated decisions D-DARKFACTORY-L4, D-AUTOLEARN-225, D-PROOF-TRACKER-219, D-PROOF-SCHEDULE-219, D-SUPPORTED-PLATFORMS-219, and D-CAPSTONE-SIGNING-219 exist. Their placeholders and issue text grant no authority. Issue #219 must remain blocked until each applicable decision is recorded through the trusted owner-action path.

blockingFindings.title: The dev-to-main delivery path is ambiguous
blockingFindings.details: The pipeline requires branches from dev, while the repository default branch and all closure evidence are main. The contract does not specify PR base branches, the dev-to-main promotion step, which revision each review and CI gate evaluates, or which branch produces the release. This prevents receipts and closure evidence from proving one deterministic delivery path.

blockingFindings.title: The lane-4 rollback prerequisite has no authorised execution path
blockingFindings.details: D-DARKFACTORY-L4 is ordered after a successful rollback drill, but the rollout definition exercises rollback in a write-enabled single lane and no separate decision authorises that prerequisite drill. The contract must either define a non-mutating rollback proof or name an authenticated, bounded authorization and evidence owner for the write-enabled drill before D-DARKFACTORY-L4 is requested.

blockingFindings.title: The autolearn brake proof and authorization are circular
blockingFindings.details: D-AUTOLEARN-225 may be recorded only after the planted-bad-adapter brake proof, while issue #225 prohibits execution before explicit owner authorization and its brake proof is executable #225 scope. The contract must define a separately authorised brake-proof-only lane or move the owner decision before that proof while limiting it to the proof.

nonBlockingNotes: D-DARKFACTORY-L4 requires the owner to select exact repositories, write actions, concurrency bounds, rollout stage, receipt schema revision, and rollback boundary.
D-AUTOLEARN-225 requires the owner to select the exact learning scope, permitted mutations, data boundary, and rollback boundary.
D-PROOF-TRACKER-219 requires the owner to select a non-circular treatment of issue #219 and its evidence and metric effects.
D-PROOF-SCHEDULE-219 requires the owner to pin the UTC clock, cadence, phase, tolerance, receipt deadline, and expected-cycle calculation.
D-SUPPORTED-PLATFORMS-219 requires the owner to pin the operating-system, architecture, runtime-profile, and evidence population.
D-CAPSTONE-SIGNING-219 requires the owner to pin the signer identity, trust source, signature scheme, verifier, revocation policy, and rotation process.
